agent_studio.chat_description: The default text model for primary conversations and direct questions. Agents without a dedicated model fall back to it.
agent_studio.chronicler_description: Extracts chapter facts, verifies continuity, and archives a fact ledger as a consistent basis for later writing and review.
agent_studio.explorer_description: Searches the internet, reads web pages, and browses internal material to collect the information and source material needed.
agent_studio.expert_team_description: Council subagents collaborate in council sessions; execution subagents complete tasks independently in conversations.
agent_studio.image_description: Generates character, scene, cover, and other image assets.
agent_studio.model_settings_description: Set the default chat and image models, then give each built-in agent its own model when needed.
agent_studio.official_experts_hint: Built-in subagents participate in council sessions. They cannot be deleted, but can be disabled or assigned a dedicated model.
agent_studio.review_description: Verifies plot logic, character consistency, world rules, and compliance with custom rules.
agent_studio.style_polish_description: Improves fluency, rhythm, and imagery without changing story facts.
agent_studio.writer_description: Specializes in long-form web-fiction drafting and writing, suited to delegated batches of four or more chapters.
